name: get_boards

fields.description: Specific fields to include in the response (default: all fields)

name: create_board
description: Create a new board with the specified properties. Use this tool to start a new project or workspace.

prefs_comments.description: Who can comment on the board

prefs_invitations.description: Who can invite members to the board

prefs_selfJoin.description: Whether members can join the board themselves

prefs_background.description: Background for the board (color or URL)

name: get_card

cardId.description: ID of the card to retrieve

fields.description: Specific fields to include in the response (default: all fields)

name: create_card
description: Create a new card on a list. Use this tool to add a new task or item to a list.

listId.description: ID of the list the card should belong to

pos.description: Position of the card (top, bottom, or a positive number)

due.description: Due date for the card (ISO-8601 format, e.g., 2023-12-31T12:00:00Z), or null

idMembers.description: Array of member IDs to assign to the card

idLabels.description: Array of label IDs to add to the card

pos.description: New position for the card (top, bottom, or a positive number)

due.description: New due date for the card (ISO-8601 format, e.g., 2023-12-31T12:00:00Z), or null to remove

idBoard.description: ID of the new board to move the card to

idMembers.description: Array of member IDs to assign to the card

idLabels.description: Array of label IDs to add to the card
